unaffected.description: True when the design still holds as it is: the engine keeps it and records that it was checked against the new inputs.

rationale.description: Why the design changes, or why it is unaffected.

design.description: The whole new design when unaffected is false, written as a Tech Design is; null when unaffected is true.

body.description: The overview: the shape of the design and its tradeoffs, briefly. Plain text. No line may start with #: the engine writes the headings.

components.description: The parts the milestone builds or changes. At least one.

name.description: A short name the Eng Lead's tickets use to say which component they change, unique in this design.

responsibility.description: What this component does and owns. Plain text. No line may start with #: the engine writes the headings.

sources.description: Globs relative to the repository root for the files this component owns, such as src/loop/** or index.html. At least one; no negated (!) globs.

tests.description: Globs for the files that hold this component's tests, such as test/loop/**. No negated (!) globs. Leave it empty only with a no_tests_reason.

no_tests_reason.description: Why this component has no tests of its own, when tests is empty; null otherwise.

complexity_notes.description: What makes it that size, such as the algorithm's cost per frame. Plain text. No line may start with #: the engine writes the headings.

rationale.description: Plain text. No line may start with #: the engine writes the headings.

performance.description: The budgets the build must meet. At least one.

how_measured.description: The command, script or check that measures it.

component.description: The component the budget is for, or null for the whole build.

test_strategy.description: How the components are tested, and what the Test Plan and the play gate check instead. Plain text. No line may start with #: the engine writes the headings.

risk.description: Plain text. No line may start with #: the engine writes the headings.

mitigation.description: Plain text. No line may start with #: the engine writes the headings.

target_artifact.description: The document id alone, such as SPEC-M1 or TEST-PLAN-M1, with no @version or #section.

target_section.description: The slug of the heading whose text you would replace, such as risks. Name this or target_ac, not both.

target_ac.description: A criterion id, such as AC-3. On a Spec, proposed_text is that criterion's new text, which the stakeholder decides. On a Test Plan, proposed_text is that criterion's new commands, one exact shell command per line.

proposed_text.description: The whole replacement for that section, criterion text or list of commands.

proposed_verification.description: Only with target_ac on a Spec: the one shell command its Verified by line should name instead, when that command is what is wrong. proposed_text still holds the criterion's text, word for word if only the command is wrong. On a Test Plan the commands are proposed_text, so leave this out.
